verdict.rationale: Mem0 has a dedicated memory-expiration feature page. You set an `expiration_date` on a memory, and once that date passes Mem0 stops surfacing it in search without deleting it. The docs say this works on both Platform and Open Source, so no cleanup job is needed. Missing for 10: any evidence of relative TTL-style durations or recency-weighted decay in ranking, and independent or hands-on corroboration that expiration works as documented.
